purpose: Teach: 覆い/明かさ/少数/気がつい/人民/調和/振れ/成人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内の問題を覆い隠すな
lines.en: Don't hide the problems within the company.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. Measured pace. Slight weight on the verb—this is non-negotiable. No softening. The voice of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、株主に進捗を明かさないわけにいきません
lines.en: Yes. We have to disclose our progress to the shareholders.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, not deferential. Steady, clear delivery. Professional certainty—he's thought this through. Slight emphasis on "have to" to show he understands the necessity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、少数株主の声も聴け
lines.en: Listen to the minority shareholders too.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Not harsh, but firm. The voice of someone who expects understanding without repeating. Even pacing. Pause before the instruction settles.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。気がついた改善点、社内、共有しております
lines.en: Yes. We're already sharing the improvements we've identified internally.
lines.style: Assured, measured response. Shows readiness and competence without overstatement. Even tone. Slight lift on "already"—a quiet confirmation that he's on top of this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人民の信頼を得る経営しろ
lines.en: Run this company so that people trust us.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Not raised volume—increased weight on each word. "Trust" gets the gravity of the directive. Unhurried, like someone speaking from principle rather than urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業績と社員満足の調和を目指しております
lines.en: Yes. We're working toward a balance between performance and employee satisfaction.
lines.style: Committed, professional affirmation. Steady delivery. Shows he's aligned with the principle. No defensiveness—just clear evidence of the goal being pursued. Warm professionalism underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 株価の振れに惑わされるな
lines.en: Don't let stock price fluctuations throw you off course.
lines.style: Steady, nearly conversational wisdom. Not barking—more like advice from experience. Slight pause before the directive sinks in. The tone of someone who's seen markets move and learned not to chase them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。成人向け新製品を展開いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll roll out the new product line aimed at adults.
lines.style: Firm conclusion. Decisive delivery—this is the action item. Controlled confidence. Slight emphasis on "will"—commitment, not prediction. Lands with finality.
